job: UK & Europe sprint 2 (Sprint A2, city first): about 30 new teachers on dev whose published base is in Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds, Liverpool, Sheffield, Nottingham, Glasgow, Edinburgh, Cork, then Berlin, Paris, Lisbon, Copenhagen (owner, 3 Nov 2026)
sources: City first: web search by city, Insight Timer profiles found by web search per city, the teachers' own sites, local centres' and studios' own teacher pages. Ranks 201-249 Birmingham, Nottingham, Sheffield; 301-349 Manchester, Leeds, Liverpool; 401-449 Glasgow, Edinburgh, Cork; 501-549 Berlin, Copenhagen; 601-649 Paris, Lisbon. BWY and UK Reiki Federation directories not used (terms forbid reuse); sites whose robots.txt blocks Claude never fetched.
